decisions.title: DINE remediation prerequisites remain unverified before deployment
decisions.note: Edit: reduced mitigation. Read-only preflight step on the workload subscription: az policy assignment list --disable-scope-strict-match must show the 4 ALZ-lite private DNS assignments and the 7 diagnostics assignments with enforcementMode Default; privateDnsZoneId parameters name the expected privatelink.* zones in rg-hub and the workspace parameter names log-management. Assignment identities' role assignments are not checked (B08's responsibility; post-deploy DNS and diagnostics checks confirm). Missing or wrong fails with 'Re-run ALZ-lite (B08)'. Applied as Task 12 step 9.

decisions.title: Defender for SQL MI adds an unpriced post-deployment charge
decisions.note: Edit: record as outside the archetype estimate, not an unpriced workload cost. Defender for SQL is enabled only because the build tenant's own Defender plans are on (owner decision: don't override tenant policies on build subscriptions; -SkipDefender). In event subscriptions ALZ-lite sets Defender for Cloud to Foundational CSPM only with every paid plan off, so members don't incur it. Step 2 estimate stays as approved. Noted in 00-handoff.md as a build-environment cost for B09 to report in its PR. Applied in the Overview carried-items row (6dec76b5).

decisions.title: Preflight does not check availability of globally unique resource names
decisions.note: Edit: accept with additions. Name-availability checks for ACR, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault and web app; a name taken by the resource in this member's own archetype RG is OK (re-runs converge); a soft-deleted vault holding the name stops and prints the az keyvault purge command; suffix and resulting name lengths (Storage alphanumeric <= 24, Key Vault <= 24) validated up front; any other collision fails before anything is created and tells the user to choose a different suffix. Applied as Task 12 steps 1 and 8.

decisions.title: Planned CodeGen outputs omit the required Azure Hybrid Benefit README guidance
decisions.note: Suggestion auto-deferred; carried to the Step 5 handoff (requirements 12 and 13: archetype README documents the AHB assumption, the LicenseIncluded switch and the MI stop/start behaviour).

decisions.title: Deployer role-assignment rights are not constrained to the approved role set
decisions.note: Owner rejects the restriction gate and keeps the documented control: vending (B08) grants each member Owner on their own dedicated, short-lived workload subscription and no role on the shared services subscription; the archetype assigns only the fixed role set at resource scope and never takes a role definition ID as a parameter. Preflight keeps checking roleAssignments/write only. Recorded as an accepted risk; a constrained-delegation role is a possible future vending change, not an archetype requirement. Documented in Task 12 step 7.

decisions.title: Partial single-deployment failures have no recovery behavior
decisions.note: Edit: accept with additions. Default recovery: fix the cause, re-run azd provision (idempotent; preflight treats the member's own resources as OK). Diagnosis: print az deployment operation sub list for failed operations. Cleanup never automatic, always a human decision; warn that a deleted MI's virtual cluster can hold snet-sqlmi for a long time; preflight checks for a leftover virtual cluster on snet-sqlmi and stops with that explanation. Failure message states that a partially created SQL MI bills at its full hourly rate, with the cost per hour. Applied as Deployment Phases > Failure and recovery and Task 12 step 2.

decisions.title: Entra telemetry authentication and delivery are not verified
decisions.note: Edit: option (b). Keep the 7 requirement-11 app settings; no APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_AUTHENTICATION_STRING. The modernized app (B06) sets the Azure Monitor distro credential to DefaultAzureCredential in code (UAMI via AZURE_CLIENT_ID); B06 validated Entra-authenticated ingestion with local auth off. Task 13 marks telemetry readiness 'pending the app image (B06/B10)'; the placeholder sends no telemetry, so telemetry readiness is never claimed at deploy time. Monitoring Metrics Publisher assignment and the diagnostic-settings check stay. Applied as Task 13 step 7 and the contract entra-telemetry evidence.

decisions.title: Azure Monitor telemetry egress through the hub firewall is unverified
decisions.note: Edit (owner 2026-10-07): capability 18 preflight (Task 12 step 6) also checks afwp-hub rcg-member-1 application rule app-to-azure-monitor and network rule app-to-entra-id, each with source snet-app and port 443, and fails closed with "rerun vending (B08)". Live evidence read 2026-10-07 recorded in the plan Overview (both rules present, source 10.20.1.0/26). Contract adds capability cap-18-telemetry-egress (owner B08 vending, afwp-hub) as an entra-telemetry dependency; the web app contract block lists the three firewall rules. Telemetry readiness stays pending the app image (B06/B10); local auth stays off. Applied as Task 12 step 6, Task 13 step 7 note, Overview live-validation row and the Code-Generation Contract.

decisions.title: The governance note asserts an Audit outcome not proven by the saved discovery
decisions.note: Owner 2026-10-07: expected result is that built-in 42781ec6 (ARM audience token authentication disabled) reports non-compliant, Audit or Disabled, never Deny; accepted trade-off for the managed identity pull. Plan wording unchanged.

decisions.title: Shared Graph-enabled UAMI is not restricted to SQL MI consumers.
decisions.note: Owner OVERRIDE, accepted risk (2026-10-07): id-sqlmi-directory holds only Graph read (User.Read.All, GroupMember.Read.All, Application.Read.All); members are tenant users with default directory read and already hold Owner on dedicated, short-lived lab subscriptions. Recorded in recall accepted_risks and Task 12 step 10.

decisions.title: No lifecycle protection is defined for the shared SQL MI identity.
decisions.note: Owner 2026-10-07: B08 dependency recorded in 00-handoff.md. ALZ-lite creates the identity and only teardown removes it; recovery is to re-run ALZ-lite, the grant script and vending. No plan change.
